10.x: An object thrown at **8 km/s** (below 11.2 km/s) **returns to Earth**; strictly, a horizontal 8 km/s above the air would orbit.
**No atmosphere on the Moon:** low gravity, so its escape velocity is **less than the RMS speed** of gas molecules, which escape.
**Re-entry blackout:** a returning shuttle heats up and **ionises the surrounding air**, so radio contact is lost for a while.

**Oberth effect:** an engine burn gives the **maximum gain when made at the highest-speed point** (perigee); lunar-mission orbit raising used repeated **perigee burns**, each raising the apogee, to save fuel.
